title: studio: every "New" entry opens on a blank technical form — offer 3–5 presets or templates first, with the full form under Advanced
body:
**Filing gate ② — a product decision only the maintainer can make.**

**Who acts on it:** objectui maintainer (Studio owner) — a product decision on the create-entry pattern. ⛔ Not a claim. Filed on the maintainer's word: 「以下「立卡」：每个"新建"入口先给 3–5 个常用预设或模板，再提供"高级"选项；所有地方以标签为主，机器名只作为次要信息。…」.

## Maintainer quick-read

Should every Studio *New* entry open on 3–5 common presets or templates (each producing a working item), with the full technical form under *Advanced*? Today each entry opens on a blank form in the platform's own vocabulary.

## Seen on 2026-10-07

- Validations *New ▾*: "Script — CEL fail condition", "Cross-field — CEL over multiple fields" — no "Required when…", "Unique", "Date after…".
- New automation asks for a name only — no trigger choice, no templates (objectstack-ai/objectui#11788).
- New action starts as sandboxed JS; a new validation rule is saved as a no-op (objectstack-ai/objectui#11820).
- New package asks for reverse-domain id, namespace, SemVer and type up front (objectstack-ai/objectui#11792).

## Options

- **A** — one pattern for every create entry (validation, automation, action, hook, field, permission set, package): a shared preset picker as the first step, presets as data so packages can contribute their own, *Blank / Advanced* last.
- **B** — presets only for validations and automations, the two entries with the most jargon.
- **C** — status quo.

## Recommendation

A. The cards above fix individual defaults; this is the cross-cutting pattern they would hang from.

## Environment

Source read on objectui `main` at `82500a7` and objectstack `main` at `033e5c53`. Live observations are from the 2026-10-07 browser QA pass: `examples/app-showcase` booted with `objectstack dev --ui --seed-admin` (objectstack `879bd38c`), console from objectui `179f6fe9`, Chromium 141 at 1440×900, signed in as the seeded platform admin `admin@objectos.ai`.

## Duplicate check

- Semantic issue search on objectstack-ai/objectui (open and closed), *validation rule presets required when unique date after instead of CEL templates for new items*: 2 hits (0 open, 2 closed).
- Related, not the same ask:
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#11788 (open) — New automation has no trigger choice or templates (one instance)
  - objectstack-ai/objectui#11820 (open) — risky or no-op defaults for New action / hook / validation (instances)
- Positive control in the same run: *related lists action id refusal notice shown to end users* on objectstack-ai/objectui returned objectstack-ai/objectui#11768: yes.

Dedupe words: studio create presets templates · new validation rule presets · blank form advanced option
